game.title: STAR WARS: The Force Unleashed II
game.blurb: Star Wars action-adventure from Aspyr Media, LucasArts Entertainment, Lucasfilm and Red Fly Studio, published by Disney Interactive and LucasArts Entertainment, released 2010-10-25. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from the achievement list on RAWG, grouped by the places it names.

chapters.title: Kamino
chapters.summary: The Kamino goals: the drill-ground turbolasers, the lightning pylons on the dive, the generators and the fans.

chapters.title: The Salvation, the Spire and the Gorog
chapters.summary: Defusing the Terror Spider Bombs and breaking the coolant tanks on the Salvation, climbing the Spire, the Terror Walker, the falling Gorog and the TIE Advanced. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Endor
chapters.summary: Finishing Endor, finishing it without dying and on Unleashed, and drop-kicking Ewoks.

chapters.title: Easy to Unleashed
chapters.summary: Finishing the game on Easy, Medium, Hard and Unleashed difficulty.

chapters.title: Challenges
chapters.summary: Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum medals in the challenges.

chapters.title: Force Powers, Combat and Holocrons
chapters.summary: Upgrading Force powers, Force Fury, every combat move, Mind Trick and Lightning feats, enemies and droids, and finding every holocron.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (star-wars-the-force-unleashed-2, id 15860). Steam app 32500 from the store list; its schema is empty, so steam=None. RAWG's detail says 47 achievements while its list has 46. RAWG lists no additions. "Endor" has its own chapter because four achievements name it and fewer players finished it (17.3%) than finished the game on Medium (36.5%); whether it is part of the main story or separate content is not in the data. Which story stage holds the Salvation, the Spire, the Terror Walker, the Gorog and the TIE Advanced was not checked; grouping them is our own choice. StrategyWiki has the guide under "Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" at completion stage 1, but only short pages are written: Enemies (about 1,200 characters), Characters (about 1,100), Walkthrough (about 660) and Table of Contents (about 640); Achievements and trophies, Controls and Gameplay are linked but not written, and no level pages are listed, so it was not used. starwars.fandom.com answers the API under "Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" with about 399 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
